issues.what: the base changes blatantly in plain sight and pops in posture: across 2828–2832 the dark fall root collar bleaches white, at 2836 the entire base flashes into a blown-out glowing peach-orange block planted dead flat on the tabletop mid-stroke, and at 2840 it snaps to the dark carved winter base while jumping high off the table on the left
issues.fix: hide the base swap behind peak storm/motion without any glowing orange-white flash, and keep elevation and tilt continuous through frame 2836 instead of dropping flush onto the table for one sample

issues.where: the tabletop scatter around the globe across frames 2828 to 2840
issues.what: clean frames are visibly half fall and half winter: white frost washes across the table while making the autumn leaves flare bright neon orange in 2828–2832, white snow clumps sit alongside bright orange fall leaves in 2836, and by 2840 the orange leaves abruptly pop out
issues.fix: never show fall leaves and winter snow together in clean frames; scatter or clear the autumn leaves with the shake before winter frost and snow arrive on the surface

issues.where: the globe shake path and tilt across frames 2808 to 2840
issues.what: the globe slides horizontally on a flat rail barely off the tabletop (sphere top varies by less than 3 px vertically across the sheet) in an even ~2.5 Hz oscillation, and its tilt has zero lag—hitting 0 degrees dead level every time it crosses center at peak horizontal speed (2812, 2824, 2836) and leaning strictly in phase with horizontal position
issues.fix: lift the globe with effort onto an arched hand path, use unequal strokes with sharp reversals, and drive tilt with angular inertia so it lags horizontal acceleration and whips after reversals rather than zeroing out at center

issues.where: the liquid and storm inside the sphere across frames 2808 to 2836
issues.what: at 2808 the fall cottage and fence remain clearly legible mid-shake before washing out in one 4-frame step (2808 to 2812), and across 2812–2836 a symmetric milky green-to-white cloud stays centered in the glass and translates with the sphere as if glued to it instead of lagging and slamming into the wall at the 2820 and 2832 reversals
issues.fix: simulate fluid and particle inertia against world-space globe acceleration so the interior lags the glass, slams against the trailing wall on reversals, and folds into an asymmetric storm

issues.where: the contact shadow and fallen leaves on the table across frames 2808 to 2824
issues.what: a hard-rimmed dark oval disc hovers and slides rigidly directly beneath the lifted base instead of a soft contact shadow that spreads and lightens with height and tilt, while the fallen leaves right under the sweeping globe stay completely frozen
issues.fix: replace the rigid floating black disc with a physically softening table shadow tied to base height and tilt, and disturb nearby loose leaves as the heavy globe lifts and sweeps close overhead

issues.where: the leaf particles inside the upper and middle dome across set-F-04.jpg through set-F-08.jpg (frames 2232 to 2338)
issues.what: the storm never turns into one slow dying whirl or clears: nearly three full seconds after landing, dense crisp orange specks are still churning rapidly across the upper dome and open sky at nearly constant coverage instead of decelerating and coming to rest on the roof, branches, and ground
issues.fix: decay the vortex angular velocity over the three seconds after landing so particles organize into one slow coherent whirl, drift downward under drag and gravity, and settle onto scene surfaces

issues.where: the globe and base across frames 2160 to 2172
issues.what: the landing lacks weight and settle: at 2160 the globe is already flat on the table, drifts ~1.5 px right and slightly upward through 2164 and back by 2172 with no downward compression or rotational rock on the base rim, then locks completely rigid
issues.fix: bring the globe down onto the table with decisive weight, an initial rim contact, a small damped rock-and-settle across the base, and matching shadow compression

issues.where: the carved jack-o'-lanterns in the base and interior fall scene across frames 2160 to 2176
issues.what: after landing, the center jack-o'-lantern and its table reflection snap from dark to bright orange in a single 2-frame step (2162 to 2164) while the eye is watching the stationary base, and inside the glass the cottage, fence, lamp, pumpkins, and bare tree are already static at full size behind fading green haze rather than growing in
issues.fix: either complete base state changes while hidden in the shake or ramp the jack-o'-lantern glow smoothly, and have the fall elements visibly grow in rather than merely unveiling static geometry through fading haze

issues.where: the glossy foreground tabletop glints near the bottom edge across frames 2234 to 2246
issues.what: single-pixel specular highlights on the dark reflective table blink on and off for individual frames (such as 2236 and 2244) during the slow camera creep
